reponse: The root cause of the November 12 ingest outage was that the disks of Kafka broker ingest-kafka-2 filled up after a retention change in infra PR #221 removed size-based retention and kept only 7-day time-based retention [2]. This caused the broker to go read-only at 09:38 UTC and stalled the consumers [2]. Although PR #388 was initially suspected due to a consumer lag spike coinciding with its deploy, it proved to be a red herring [1][5].
